title: Reflexive 7: Being Afraid (+ genitive)
description: Бояться (to be afraid of) and стесняться (to be shy of) name the source of the feeling in the genitive, not the accusative. Антон боится темноты, not темноту.
descriptionRussian: Глаголы бояться и стесняться ставят источник страха или смущения в родительный падеж, а не в винительный. Антон боится темноты, а не темноту.
intro: Another verb that exists only with the ending, and like the last one it demands a particular case after it. Being afraid takes the genitive in Russian, which is worth learning as a fact rather than reasoning about: nothing in the meaning of fear predicts it. Two verbs, one case, learned together.
rules: Бояться means 'to be afraid of.' The thing you fear goes in the genitive: Антон боится темноты.
Стесняться means 'to be shy of' or 'to be embarrassed by.' It takes the same genitive: Маша стесняется новых людей.
Never use the accusative here. Боюсь темноту is wrong; the correct form is боюсь темноты.
Use the genitive endings you already know: темнота → темноты, собака → собаки, паук → паука, plural собака → собак.
examples: Антон боится темноты. (Anton is afraid of the dark.) бояться + gen; темнота → темноты.
Маша боится собак. (Masha is afraid of dogs.) бояться + gen; plural собака → собак.
Лена боится грозы. (Lena is afraid of the thunderstorm.) бояться + gen; гроза → грозы.
Антон стесняется новых людей. (Anton is shy of new people.) стесняться + gen; люди → людей.
Маша стесняется своего голоса. (Masha is embarrassed by her voice.) стесняться + gen; голос → голоса.
Дети боятся паука. (The children are afraid of the spider.) бояться + gen; паук → паука.

items.promptEnglish: Anton is afraid of the dark.
items.hint: Бояться takes which case for the thing feared?
items.explanation: Бояться + genitive. Темнота is feminine -а; its genitive is темноты. The accusative темноту copies the English 'fear the dark' pattern but бояться never takes the accusative.

items.hint: 'Dogs' is plural. What is the genitive plural of собака?
items.explanation: Бояться + genitive, and 'dogs' is plural here. The genitive plural of собака is собак (feminine -а words drop the ending).

items.promptEnglish: The children are afraid of the spider.
items.hint: Паук is masculine. What is its genitive ending?
items.explanation: Бояться + genitive. Паук is a masculine consonant noun, so the genitive adds -а: паука.

items.promptEnglish: Masha is shy of new people.
items.hint: Стесняться takes the genitive too. What is the genitive of люди (people)?
items.explanation: Стесняться + genitive, just like бояться. The genitive plural of люди is людей (a special form). The adjective новых is already in the genitive plural to match.

items.promptEnglish: Lena is afraid of the thunderstorm.
items.hint: Same rule as темнота. Гроза is feminine -а.
items.explanation: Бояться + genitive. Гроза is feminine -а; its genitive is грозы. The accusative грозу is the English-style object that бояться rejects.

items.promptEnglish: Anton is embarrassed by his voice.
items.hint: Стесняться + genitive. Голос is masculine consonant.
items.explanation: Стесняться + genitive. Голос is a masculine consonant noun; its genitive adds -а: голоса. The possessive своего is already in the genitive masculine to match.

items.hint: Бояться takes which case? Dogs here is plural.
items.explanation: Бояться takes the genitive: боится собак (genitive plural).

items.promptEnglish: Anton is embarrassed by his mistake.
items.hint: Стесняться patterns like бояться. Which case?
items.explanation: Стесняться also takes the genitive: стесняется своей ошибки. Ошибку is the English-style accusative object; the -ся fear / embarrassment verbs all reach for the genitive.

items.promptEnglish: The boy is afraid of the thunderstorm.
items.hint: Бояться + genitive. Гроза is a feminine -а noun.
items.explanation: Feminine -а nouns take -ы in the genitive: боится грозы. Грозу is the English-style accusative; after бояться only the genitive is correct.

blanks: Маленький мальчик боится _____. (The little boy is afraid of the water.)
Лена стесняется своей _____. (Lena is embarrassed by her mistake.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Both бояться and стесняться take the genitive. Вода → воды and ошибка → ошибки (both feminine -а). The accusative forms воду and ошибку copy the English object pattern and are wrong here.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton has been afraid of heights since childhood.
errorCorrection.explanation: Бояться takes the genitive, so 'heights' is высоты (высота → genitive высоты). The accusative высоту copies the English 'fear heights' object pattern, but бояться never takes an accusative object.

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша стесняется новые люди на работе.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha is shy of new people at work.
errorCorrection.explanation: Стесняться takes the genitive, so 'new people' is новых людей: люди → genitive plural людей, with the adjective новых matching in the genitive plural. Новые люди is the nominative (subject-only), not the genitive стесняться needs.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The children are afraid of the neighbour's big dog.
errorCorrection.explanation: Бояться takes the genitive, so the singular 'big dog' is большой собаки: собака → genitive собаки, with the adjective большой in the genitive feminine. Большую собаку is the accusative carried over from English. The genitive is fixed for this verb.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton is afraid of the dark.
minimalPairs.explanation: Бояться takes the genitive: темноты. The accusative темноту is the English-style object that this verb refuses. Whenever you see бояться, reach for the genitive.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha is shy of new people.
minimalPairs.explanation: Стесняться takes the genitive: новых людей. Новых людям mixes a genitive adjective with a dative noun, which does not agree and is not the frame this verb wants. The whole phrase must be genitive.

patternRecognition.question: Why is грозы in the genitive here?
options: Because бояться puts the thing feared in the genitive
Because гроза is the subject of the sentence
Because there is a number before it
patternRecognition.answer: Because бояться puts the thing feared in the genitive
patternRecognition.explanation: Бояться always sends the source of fear into the genitive: гроза → грозы. There is no number and no preposition here; the case comes straight from the verb.

patternRecognition.question: What case is своего голоса, and why?
options: Genitive, because стесняться takes the genitive
Accusative, because it is the object
patternRecognition.answer: Genitive, because стесняться takes the genitive
patternRecognition.explanation: Стесняться behaves like бояться: the source of embarrassment goes in the genitive. Голос → голоса and the possessive своего matches in the genitive masculine.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Anton is afraid of the dark.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Бояться + genitive: темнота → темноты. Put the subject first.

sentenceBuilding.translation: Masha is shy of new people.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Стесняться + genitive plural: люди → людей, with новых matching.

sentenceBuilding.translation: The children are afraid of the spider.
sentenceBuilding.hint: Бояться + genitive: паук → паука. Plural subject takes боятся.

reviewVocab.definition: to be afraid of (the thing feared goes in the genitive, never the accusative): бояться темноты, бояться собак
to be shy of, to be embarrassed by (the source goes in the genitive): стесняться новых людей, стесняться своего голоса
the dark (feminine -а noun); its genitive after бояться is темноты, not темноту
